description: Semeando Águas do Paraguaçu. Fragmentação e Conectividade. Vetor 1:50.000. 2016 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Dado vetorial que indica áreas de conectividade e fragmentação da vegetação. Este estudo foi realizado pela CI-Brasil sobre os resultados do Mapeamento de Vegetação e Solo (ECONAMFI, 2015) realizado no âmbito do Projeto SAP. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Remanescentes, environment. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
